asset_heavy.reason: Mostly online education with some campuses and simulation labs; not heavy plants or fleets, though 28 campuses need some investment.

big_ticket.reason: Tuition is paid per course or term in modest installments, though a whole degree adds up over time.

cyclical_demand.reason: Education for military, working adults and nursing students; enrollment is often countercyclical and nursing demand is steady.

large_customers.reason: Students are individuals, mostly servicemembers, veterans and working adults, though tuition assistance comes from government.

notes: Tuition is often funded by military tuition assistance or federal aid, but students are the buyers.

offers_products.reason: It sells education programs (degrees, certificates, diplomas), not goods or software.

offers_services.reason: Delivers instruction through American Military University, Rasmussen University and Hondros College of Nursing.

people_delivered.reason: Education is delivered by faculty and instructors; students pay mainly for teaching time and expertise.

recurring_revenue.reason: Students re-enroll and pay tuition course by course or term over multi-year programs.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Students at AMU, APU, Rasmussen and Hondros choose and receive the education, including servicemembers and working professionals.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Main buyers are individual students; employer alliances exist but are minor.
